title: Choose Manggahan Active's visual world
question: Choose the interface direction that should shape the player booking flow and staff schedule.

options.label: Locker Ledger
options.lineage: sports-complex locker tags, magnetic schedule boards, and equipment-room labels
options.thesis: A reservation becomes a claim tag that moves visibly from an open court slot into the player's booking.
options.viewport: A compact sport rail anchors the left, a large week schedule reads like a bank of labeled lockers, and the chosen slot pulls into a booking pass on the right.
options.risk: The tag metaphor can feel cramped if labels and availability are not given enough breathing room.

raised.raise: Registration marks and strict alignment give every time slot print-level precision.
Every booking step stays visibly reversible instead of trapping the player.
Capacity and remaining slots use disciplined tabular figures rather than decorative statistics.

options.label: Courtline Scheduler
options.lineage: painted court geometry, referee score sheets, and community recreation signage
options.thesis: Availability is drawn directly into court geometry, so choosing a time feels like stepping onto the playing surface.
options.viewport: A bold date-and-sport rail cuts across a court-line schedule, while one oversized next-available slot becomes the primary booking action.
options.risk: It is the most immediately understandable direction, but also the one closest to familiar sports-app territory.

options.label: Arrival Board
options.lineage: depot destination blinds translated into a live facility timetable
options.thesis: Facilities move through the day like destinations, with each open slot flipping cleanly into a confirmed reservation.
options.viewport: A fixed time window frames stacked facility courses; the chosen row snaps forward and opens a calm booking sheet beneath it.
options.case: The timetable mechanism is exceptionally clear and memorable, though it identifies with transit before sport.
options.risk: Too much mechanical motion could slow a task that should feel immediate.

options.label: Registered Schedule
options.lineage: a design annual's precisely registered plate section
options.thesis: Every facility and time is laid out with the calm precision of a signed print edition.
options.viewport: A continuous near-white schedule sheet with a circular confirmation stamp and strict twelve-column alignment.
options.case: Product clarity holds, but the world does not identify strongly enough with community sport.
options.risk: It can feel like a portfolio archive instead of an active reservation tool.

options.label: Side A / Side B
options.lineage: a handwritten cassette j-card timed to fit each side
options.thesis: Morning and evening schedules become two tightly timed sides of one folded daily card.
options.viewport: The booking day unfolds into morning and evening tracklists with durations aligned at the edge.
options.case: The time metaphor is charming but makes reservation status less immediate than the grounded directions.
options.kept: Every schedule must fit a visible time budget.
options.risk: Handwritten density could reduce scanability and accessibility.

options.label: Kinetic Playbook
options.lineage: an alphabet storm where type behaves as physical matter
options.thesis: Sport names and times reorganize into live schedules as the player changes filters.
options.viewport: A monumental sport name breaks into the available time grid while the form remains anchored below.
options.case: The motion is memorable but competes with the operational task and weakens quick scanning.
options.kept: One orchestrated transformation should explain cause and effect.
options.risk: Expressive typography could obscure the familiar booking controls players need.

options.label: Folded Booking
options.lineage: a single sheet progressing through a recoverable origami sequence
options.thesis: The reservation form folds from facility to schedule to details without ever losing its previous state.
options.viewport: A central booking sheet changes shape across three steps, with the current crease highlighted in gold.
options.case: The reversible flow is strong, but the visual identity says craft instruction more than sports access.
options.kept: Every step remains recoverable and deep-linkable.
options.risk: The folding metaphor may make a simple form feel more complex than it is.

options.label: Capacity Counter
options.lineage: a nixie-tube laboratory counter organized around changing quantities
options.thesis: Availability, capacity, and reservation counts glow as the central instrument panel.
options.viewport: Large glowing availability digits lead, with facilities and time choices arranged as instrument banks beneath.
options.case: Counts become beautifully legible, but players need names, dates, and actions more than spectacle around numbers.
options.kept: Numerical states use fixed positions and tabular rhythm.
options.risk: The dark laboratory character feels exclusive rather than community-oriented.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A familiar polished sports-booking dashboard with facility cards, a calendar, and a conventional checkout flow.
canonCard.viewport: A standard top navigation, search banner, facility-card grid, and right-side availability calendar.
canonCard.risk: Easy to understand, but indistinguishable from competing booking products by design.
